001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 * The smallest element in the set. Does nothing if the set is empty.
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropSetMin extends Propagator<Variable> {
018
019    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
020
021    private final SetVar set;
022    private final IntVar setCard;
023    private final IntVar min;
024    private final int defaultValue;
025
026    public PropSetMin(SetVar set, IntVar setCard, IntVar min, int defaultValue) {
027        super(new Variable[]{set, setCard, min}, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
028        this.set = set;
029        this.setCard = setCard;
030        this.min = min;
031        this.defaultValue = defaultValue;
032    }
033
034    @Override
035    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
036        if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
037            min.updateUpperBound(set.getLB().min(), this);
038        }
039
040        int lb = min.getLB();
041        while (lb <= min.getUB() && !set.getUB().contains(lb)) {
042            lb = min.nextValue(lb);
043        }
044        ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
045        int i;
046        while (iter.hasNext() && (i = iter.nextInt()) < lb) {
047            set.remove(i, this);
048        }
049        if (!set.getLB().isEmpty() && set.getLB().size() + 1 == setCard.getUB()) {
050            iter.reset();
051            int kerMin = set.getLB().min();
052            while (iter.hasNext()) {
053                i = iter.nextInt();
054                if (i < kerMin && !min.contains(i)) {
055                    set.remove(i, this);
056                }
057            }
058        }
059
060        if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
061            int nextCard = setCard.nextValue(set.getLB().size());
062            if (nextCard > 0 && nextCard <= setCard.getUB()) {
063                int kerMin = set.getLB().isEmpty() || !setCard.contains(set.getLB().size()) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : set.getLB().min();
064                int remove = PropUtil.getEnv(set, set.getUB().size() - nextCard);
065                remove = min.nextValue(remove);
066                if (kerMin < remove && (defaultValue < remove || setCard.getLB() > 0)) {
067                    min.updateUpperBound(remove - 1, this);
068                } else {
069                    while (remove <= min.getUB()) {
070                        if (remove != kerMin) {
071                            if (defaultValue != remove || setCard.getLB() > 0) {
072                                min.removeValue(remove, this);
073                            }
074                        }
075                        remove = min.nextValue(remove);
076                    }
077                }
078            }
079        }
080    }
081
082    @Override
083    public ESat isEntailed() {
084        if (setCard.getLB() > 0 || !set.getLB().isEmpty() || !min.contains(defaultValue)) {
085            int kerMin = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
086            int index = set.getUB().size() - setCard.getLB();
087            if (index >= 0 && index < set.getUB().size()) {
088                kerMin = PropUtil.getEnv(set, index);
089            }
090            if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
091                kerMin = set.getLB().min();
092            }
093            if (kerMin != Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
094                int prev = min.previousValue(kerMin + 1);
095                int lb = min.getLB();
096                while (prev >= lb && !set.getUB().contains(prev)) {
097                    prev = min.previousValue(prev);
098                }
099                if (!set.getUB().contains(prev)) {
100                    return ESat.FALSE;
101                }
102                if (min.isInstantiated() && kerMin == set.getUB().min()) {
103                    return ESat.TRUE;
104                }
105            }
106            if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
107                int nextCard = setCard.getLB();
108                if (nextCard == 0) {
109                    nextCard = setCard.nextValue(nextCard);
110                }
111                if (nextCard > 0 && nextCard <= setCard.getUB()) {
112                    int remove = PropUtil.getEnv(set, set.getUB().size() - nextCard);
113                    if (min.previousValue(remove + 1) < min.getLB()) {
114                        return ESat.FALSE;
115                    }
116                }
117            }
118        }
119        if (setCard.getUB() == 0 && min.isInstantiated()) {
120            return ESat.eval(min.getValue() == defaultValue);
121        }
122        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
123    }
124
125    @Override
126    public String toString() {
127        return "min(" + set + ", " + setCard + ", " + min + ")";
128    }
129}
